title: tinyactors run
description: The protocol of `tinyactors run`: JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line, between a client and one host. A client writes a `clientMessage` per line and reads a `serverMessage` per line. The server's own methods are `run.*`; every other method is forwarded to the host's control plane (docs/requests.md). Effects reach the client as `effect.*` notifications. Values are JSON; where JSON cannot hold a value (bytes, undefined, a non-finite float, a tag), its CBOR comes too, base64url without padding, as the field's twin (`data` and `cbor`, `params` and `paramsCBOR`). Experimental: the protocol may change in any release.

clientMessage.description: One line a client writes: a request, a notification (a request without `id`, applied with no response), or a batch of them.

serverMessage.description: One line the server writes: a response, a notification (`effect.*`), or a batch of responses.

requestBatch.description: A JSON-RPC batch: each element runs in order, as if sent alone; the responses come as one array after the last (none when every element was a notification). An empty array is refused.

responseBatch.description: The responses to a batch, in its order.

id.description: A request's id, echoed in its response; `null` in the response to a message that could not be read.

uint64.description: An unsigned integer of 64 bits: it reaches 2^64-1, past what a double holds exactly; a client that cares parses integers as big integers.

session.description: A session id, from 1; it reaches 2^64-1 (segment k numbers its sessions from k * 2^32 + 1).

chartIndex.description: A chart's index in its segment's image.

invocation.description: The token of an invocation the client runs, from its `effect.invoke`.

ticks.description: The host's clock in ticks at `system.ticksPerSecond` (default 1e9: nanoseconds); it reaches 2^64-1.

duration.description: A duration as SCXML writes a delay: a number and `s` or `ms` (`"30s"`, `"150ms"`, `"0.5s"`), converted to ticks with `ticksPerSecond`.

target.description: A session, or a local address the server resolves.

traceparent.description: A W3C traceparent, as text; text that does not parse starts a new trace.

base64url.description: Bytes as base64url without padding (RFC 4648, section 5).

value.description: A neutral value as JSON: integers to 64 bits, floats, text, arrays, objects with text keys, true, false, null. Written, bytes are base64url text, undefined and non-finite floats null, and a tag its item (an address its text); the value's `cbor` twin then comes too.

cbor.description: A neutral value's CBOR (RFC 8949), base64url without padding: the twin of a value JSON cannot hold exactly. On input it stands instead of the value; on output it follows the value when writing it changed something.

noParams.description: A method that takes no params: `params` absent, or an empty object.

empty.description: A result with nothing in it.

error.description: A JSON-RPC error, core's shape: `code` and `reason` say what happened, `path` where (`"params.events[2].data"`, `""` for the message as a whole); `message` is for people. The server's own errors add `status`, the name of the status a C call refused with.

code.description: -32700 not JSON or a repeated key; -32600 not a request; -32601 no such method; -32602 a param refused; -32001 stale; -32002 state (a batch is held, or the host cannot now); -32003 limit; -32004 memory; -32005 invalid; -32006 malformed bytes or data; -32007 unsupported; -32603 internal.

status.description: `ta_status_name` of the refused call's status, such as `TA_ERROR_STATE`.

response.description: The response to a request: its `result`, or an `error`.

runStatus.description: How a turn ended: `idle` (nothing runnable; `nextDeadline` says when a delayed send is due), `yielded` (`runs` spent, actors still runnable), `held` (a batch is left open for the client), `exhausted` (a pool could not grow; `detail` names it), `fault` (`detail` is the status's name).

diagnostic.description: A compiler diagnostic, as `tinyactors check --format json` writes it.

span.description: A span, as `trace.spans.decode` answers it: `trace` and `span` lowercase hex, `parent` hex or null for a root span, `kind` and `status` OTLP's numbers, `start` and `end` nanoseconds since the Unix epoch on the host's wall clock.

attributes.description: Key to value; a list value an array, a key-value list an object, anything deeper null.

traceRule.description: A trace rule (docs/requests.md, "Trace rules"); each field it leaves out matches anything.

actor.description: An actor's name; a trailing `*` makes it a prefix.

event.description: An event descriptor, SCXML's prefix rule.

sample.description: What a match decides: keep, sample, drop, or the share of trace ids sampled.

stateValue.description: A configuration as a nested state value, xstate's `value`: an atomic state is its id; a compound state `{"<id>": <its active child>}`; a parallel state `{"<id>": {"<region>": ...}}`; an atomic region `{}`.

request.description: A request (with `id`) or a notification (without), discriminated by `method`. A method this schema does not list is forwarded to the host, which answers -32601 when it does not know it.

run.addImage.params.description: Compile charts, or take an image, and add it as a new segment: exactly one of `files` (paths, read as the command's inputs are), `sources` (charts as text, the first the default boot chart; a `src` names another by its name) or `image` (a compiled image, `.tai`).

run.boot.params.description: Spawn the boot actors of a segment's manifest (`ta_host_boot`).

run.chart.params.description: The current version of a chart (`ta_host_chart`).

run.spawn.params.description: Spawn an actor (`ta_host_spawn`): `chart` a name (its current version), or `segment` and `chart` an index. `params` (or `paramsCBOR`) bind the chart's `<data>` at its first macrostep.

run.send.params.description: An event for an actor (`ta_host_send`), with every field of `ta_event_in`. To answer a send from an `effect.send`, pass its `sendid` and `origintype` (the processor's type). As a service the client runs, pass `invocation` (the token of its `effect.invoke`), and `done` to end it (`event` is then core's `done.invoke.<id>`).

run.sendMany.params.description: Events in order (`ta_host_send_many`); it stops at the first refused.

accepted.description: The length of the accepted prefix.

run.fail.params.description: Fail a send (`error.communication` in its sender's queue: `target` and the send's `sendid`), or an invocation the client runs (`target` and its `invocation`).

run.resolve.params.description: The session a local address names (`ta_host_resolve`).

run.actorByName.params.description: The oldest live actor spawned under a name (`ta_host_actor_by_name`).

run.advanceTime.params.description: Move the simulated clocks (`ta_host_advance_time`): monotonic time `by` a duration or `to` a time, wall time by the same duration, or to `wallNs`. Nothing runs.

run.turn.params.description: Run the host until it is idle, at most `runs` runs of `budget` fuel each, with every effect written as an `effect.*` notification before the response. With `hold`, a batch with a waiting send only the client decides is left open (`status` `held`) until the client's next `run.turn` or `run.ack`.

detail.description: For `exhausted`, the pool; for `fault`, the status's name.

nextDeadline.description: null: none. Not to be relied on when `status` is `held` (null, or the deadline the segments had before): the run that stops at waiting sends does not compute its segment's, and the next `run.turn` answers it.

run.hibernate.params.description: Hibernate an actor at rest (`ta_host_hibernate`): its blob is the client's to keep.

run.wake.params.description: Wake a hibernated actor from its blob (`ta_host_wake`).

run.sweep.params.description: The CLOCK sweep (`ta_host_sweep`): scan at most `maxScan` actors, answer at most `limit` at rest to hibernate.

run.migrate.params.description: Move actors to the current version of their chart (`ta_host_migrate`): every chart, one chart by name, or one session; `wake` asks for hibernated actors too (`effect.wake`); `timeout` ends it.

run.snapshot.params.description: A snapshot of the quiescent host (`ta_host_snapshot_pack`, with quickjs's state and the wall clock), answered, or written whole to `path`. Refused (-32002) while a batch is held and while a migration runs, until its `effect.migrationDone`.

run.restore.params.description: Replace the host with one restored from a snapshot `run.snapshot` wrote for the same system, given or read from `path`, with the server's config and datamodel limits. Refused (-32002) while a batch is held. The next `run.turn` announces each invocation that was running (`effect.invoke` with `restored`).

run.restore.result.description: The restored host's live segments, and its clocks: the snapshot's time, which may be earlier than the replaced host's.

run.post.params.description: A message for `ta_host_post` as CBOR, as given: for bytes JSON cannot carry, and to read a reply's exact values.

reply.description: The reply's CBOR; absent for a message without id.

trace.configure.params.description: Forwarded to the host: what every segment traces.

trace.watch.params.description: Forwarded to the host: rules in front of the configured ones, for `seconds` on the host's clock (null: no end; core refuses 1e9 and past).

trace.unwatch.params.description: Forwarded to the host: end a watch early.

trace.spans.decode.params.description: Forwarded to the host, which takes `traces` as CBOR bytes only: a JSON string reaches it as text and is refused (`type`). Send it with `run.post`.

host.config.result.description: The host's effective config, every default filled in, in core's shape: `ioProcessors` is core's list.

actor.list.params.description: Forwarded to the host: the sessions, a page at a time.

cursor.description: Opaque, from the previous result; 0: the start.

actor.get.params.description: Forwarded to the host: one session.

parent.description: The session that invoked it; null for a root actor.

actor.context.params.description: Forwarded to the host: a session's variables.

variables.description: Each `<data>` id to its value; undefined is written null (`run.post` tells them apart).

actor.send.params.description: Forwarded to the host: an event for one actor, by `session` or local `address`. `run.send` takes every field of `ta_event_in`.

actor.state.params.description: Forwarded to the host: a session's configuration.

history.description: Each history state that recorded to where it would return, as a state value.

notification.description: An effect the host handed out, written before the response to the request that caused it, discriminated by `method`. Every one carries `batch` (the server's count of batches) and `index` (its place in the batch); a field the effect does not set is left out.

transportMessage.description: A send to another system's address, as the other system's `run.send` takes it unchanged.

effect.send.params.description: A `<send>` the client handles: to an I/O processor of the config (`type`), to another system (`message`, for the transport), or to a service the client runs (`invocation` and `segment`). `waiting`: the sender waits for the batch's ack, so an answer given before it is in its queue when it goes on.

effect.invoke.params.description: An `<invoke>` of a service: the client runs every one. Answer with `run.send` (`invocation`, and `done` to end it) or `run.fail`. `restored`: announced again by a restored host's first turn.

effect.uninvoke.params.description: An invocation cancelled: stop its stand-in. `session` is its invoker's; the token is stale from now on.

effect.request.params.description: A chart asked for a chart its image lacks; the server refuses it (the parent gets `error.execution`).

effect.wake.params.description: A hibernated actor is wanted again: `run.wake` it with the blob `run.hibernate` gave. `migration`: a migration asked for it.

effect.done.params.description: A top-level actor reached a final state: its name, the final state's id, and its donedata.

effect.error.params.description: A top-level actor ended on a fault: `status` names it.

effect.migrated.params.description: An actor moved to a new version: its segment and chart now.

effect.migrationDone.params.description: A migration ended: how many moved, those that failed with their status, and those it left pending (hibernated, not woken).

effect.logs.params.description: Log records the host staged, as an OTLP ExportLogsServiceRequest.
